metrics.name: First-week activation
asks: Where do new members drop off in their first 7 days
Share who join a board, connect and post within 7 days of signup
definition: Members at least 7 days past signup (signup week starts Monday)
Joined a board → shared a board with another member → first post → another member commented on or liked their post
Every step within 7 days of signup, after the previous step

metrics.name: Retention by first-week connection
asks: Do members who connect in their first week stay longer
definition: Members who joined a board within 7 days of signup
Whether they shared a board with another member within 7 days
Wn = at least one post, comment or like in days [7n, 7n+7) after signup; only members whose window has fully passed count in the denominator

metrics.name: Weekly retention by signup week
asks: How many weeks do new members stay active
definition: Members who signed up on or after cohort_start
Wn = at least one post, comment or like in days [7n, 7n+7) after signup; only members whose window has fully passed count in the denominator
Members who left stay in the denominator

metrics.name: Weekly writing activity
asks: How many posts, comments and likes are made each week
definition: Posts, comments, replies and likes (deleted ones still count when they were made)
